data.name: Khayzoor
data.gender_notes: Khayzoor is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khayzoor is derived from the Arabic word 'Khizar', meaning 'green'. It symbolizes beauty, fertility, and abundance. The name Khayzoor carries the meaning “Embellished with green” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Khayzoor usually hope their child will grow to embody embellished with green and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khayzoor total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: خَيْزُور

in_urdu.name: خیزور
in_urdu.meaning: خیزور کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور بہادر شخص

in_hindi.name: ख़ैज़ूर
in_hindi.meaning: ख़ैज़ूर का अर्थ है शक्तिशाली और बहादुर व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: ख़ैज़ूर नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के मूल जड़ خ-ي-ز से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति और साहस। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक मजबूत और निडर व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: خېزور

in_english.name: Khayzoor
in_english.long_meaning: The name Khayzoor is derived from the Arabic root خ-ي-ز (kh-y-z), which signifies strength and bravery. Historically, this name has been used in various Islamic cultures to describe a powerful and courageous person. The etymology of Khayzoor is linked to the concept of resilience and valor, making it a significant name in Islamic tradition.
